headline: arXivLabs launches framework for community-driven feature development
summary: arXivLabs introduces a new framework enabling collaborators to develop and share features directly on the arXiv website. It emphasizes openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy, partnering only with those who adhere to these values.
details: arXivLabs has officially launched a new framework designed to empower collaborators to develop and integrate new features directly onto the arXiv website. This initiative aims to enrich the platform's functionality through community contributions.

The framework is built upon core values of openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy. arXiv is committed to upholding these principles and partners exclusively with individuals and organizations that share these ethical standards.

Individuals and organizations interested in contributing to arXiv's community through innovative projects are encouraged to learn more about arXivLabs. The platform provides a direct avenue for developing and sharing valuable new tools.
caption:
arXiv is opening its platform for community-driven innovation! A new framework allows developers to build and share features directly on the site.

arXivLabs has officially launched a new framework designed to empower collaborators to develop and integrate new features directly onto the arXiv website. This initiative aims to enrich the platform's functionality through community contributions.

The framework is built upon core values of openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy. arXiv is committed to upholding these principles and partners exclusively with individuals and organizations that share these ethical standards.

Individuals and organizations interested in contributing to arXiv's community through innovative projects are encouraged to learn more about arXivLabs. The platform provides a direct avenue for developing and sharing valuable new tools.
